title: Resource Pool
text: Pool entity resources, 1 input, 3 outputs; {Resource name} sets the name for the resources in the pool, {Resource granularity} selects granularity of resource use Discrete, {Reusable upon release} sets the if the resource is reusable upon release, {Resource amount source} selects resource amount, {Resource amount} sets the amount of resource, {Initial resource amount} sets the initial amount of resource, {Resource visibility} selects the availability of the resources, {Amount in use, u} sets the number of resources that are in use, {Average utilization, util} sets the outputs the average resource utilization and {Amount available, avail} sets the outputs the amount of resources available. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: Port_1
ports.summary: Change resource amount scalar | vector | matrix

ports.name: Port_u
ports.summary: Outputs the number of resources that are in use scalar

ports.name: Port_util
ports.summary: Outputs the average time the pool is utilized scalar

ports.name: Port_avail
ports.summary: Outputs the number of resources that are available scalar

params.name: Resource name
params.values: Name for the resources in the pool Resource1 (default) | character vector

params.name: Resource granularity
params.values: Select granularity of resource use Discrete unit (default) | Fractional amount

params.name: Reusable upon release
params.values: Specify if the resource is reusable upon release off (default) | on

params.name: Resource amount source
params.values: Select resource amount source Dialog (default) | Change amount through control port

params.name: Resource amount
params.values: Set the amount of resource 10 (default) | scalar

params.name: Initial resource amount
params.values: Enter initial amount of resource 10 (default) | scalar

params.name: Resource visibility
params.values: Select the availability of the resources Global (default) | Scoped

params.name: Amount in use, u
params.values: Number of resources that are in use off (default) | on

params.name: Average utilization, util
